lines.en: My legs are short; I run like a rolling ball.

lines.zh: 母亲在前头，我踩她的印
lines.en: Mother leads; I step in her prints.
The ground I cross is always wet.
Do not call me slow; I will keep up.
There are many of us, walking in a line.

lines.zh: 脚上有黏液，走两步滑一步
lines.en: Slime on my feet; two steps, one slide.

lines.zh: 我排第四，前面还有三只
lines.en: I am fourth; three more walk ahead.

lines.zh: 跑快点，母亲要看不见了
lines.en: Hurry; I am losing sight of mother.
I watch behind me while I walk.
The floor is hard and my hooves ache.

lines.zh: 我要跟到主人的靴子边
lines.en: I must reach my master's boots.
Do not push; we will all get there.
I am waiting for mother's next brood.

lines.zh: 十二只挤成一团，地板都暖了
lines.en: Twelve of us huddle and the floor warms.
I am smallest and always pushed outside.

lines.zh: 别看我，我在数兄弟姐妹
lines.en: Do not watch; I am counting my siblings.

lines.zh: 这间屋子有奶味和铁味
lines.en: This room smells of milk and iron.

lines.zh: 我啃自己的触手，一会儿就长回来
lines.en: I chew my own tendril; it grows back soon.

lines.zh: 主人没叫我，我就不能动
lines.en: My master has not called, so I stay still.
I listen for the bell; when it rings, I charge.
I am sleepy, but I dare not close my eyes.
Wind in the wall cracks sounds like breathing.

lines.zh: 我试着学母亲那样站直
lines.en: I try standing tall the way mother does.
I hide beneath her belly.
This place is too bright for me.

lines.zh: 我数自己有几条腿，数乱了
lines.en: I counted my legs and lost the count.
I doze against my mother's leg
There is blood on the floor; I go lick it

lines.zh: 我到你膝盖，抬头很费劲
lines.en: I reach your knee; looking up is hard work.
Did my master bring you back?

lines.zh: 你的靴子好干净，我不敢碰
lines.en: Your boots are clean; I dare not touch them.
Looking up at you takes a long time.
Will you eat us too?
I am waiting for you to touch me once.
There are two of me in your eyes.
Mother says we must not bite guests.

lines.zh: 你身上没有黏液，好奇怪
lines.en: You have no slime on you; how strange.
I am wagging; can you see it?
Do not stamp your foot; we scatter.
I am learning your scent; hold still.

lines.zh: 你蹲下，我才敢闻你的鞋
lines.en: Crouch down and I will dare sniff your boot.

lines.zh: 你会留下来吗，一会儿就好
lines.en: Will you stay? Even a little while.

lines.zh: 肋骨响了一声，牙还能用
lines.en: A rib cracked; my teeth still work.
Do not hit my head; it spins.

lines.zh: 右前腿折了，我还有五条
lines.en: My right foreleg snapped; five still carry me.
Mother is watching; I cannot fall.
That kick landed harder than my master's.

lines.zh: 绿色的血溅到你靴子上了
lines.en: Green blood splashed onto your boots.
I curled up and your swing missed.
We were never afraid of pain.
Break me and another brood follows.
I screamed; mother will come.
Is it for us? All of it?
Let me smell it, then one small bite.
Mother says we cannot eat first.
This is not enough to share; I bite first.
I never get full; there are too many of us.
Save me a piece, just a small one.
It is sweet; I want more.
Do not give it to only one; we will fight.
I will run with it in my mouth; nobody take it.

lines.zh: 吃了这个我能跑更快吗
lines.en: Will this make me run faster?
Sorry, I am too crowded here.

lines.zh: 靴子压住我尾巴尖了，抬一下
lines.en: Your boot pins my tail tip; lift it.
We are one brood; bumping is unavoidable.
Make room; I am going back to mother.

lines.zh: 撞倒我没事，我会爬起来
lines.en: Knock me down; I will get up.
Your knee hit my head.
Do not fear; I am only slippery.
I walk against you so I do not get lost.
Squeeze in; the door is only this wide.
I tripped you; my apology.
I am still small; that comes later.
Mother births for us; we need not.

lines.zh: 我们生出来就是为了打
lines.en: We were born to fight.

lines.zh: 别找我，我随时会被吃掉
lines.en: Not me; I could be eaten any moment.
I do not even have a name.
Ask me when I am grown.
This whole brood is my kin.
You asked the wrong one; ask mother.
I will not live that long.
Breeding is mother's business.
I can reach it; I have many limbs.
Can I bring this back to my master?
Dropped it; I will fetch it again.

lines.zh: 我叼着这个，就咬不动你了
lines.en: With this in my mouth I cannot bite you.

lines.zh: 松口，我先叼到的那块归我
lines.en: Let go; the piece I grabbed first is mine.
Too heavy; let us do it together.

lines.zh: 我把它藏在母亲肚子下面
lines.en: I will hide it under mother's belly.
Got it; watch me run.

lines.zh: 我不认识这是什么，但我会拿
lines.en: I do not know what it is, but I will carry it.
Give it to me and I will lead the way.
My master pointed, so I go.
You are bigger; I am not afraid.
Ten of us against one of you.
Mother is watching from behind.
If I bite you, I win.
You struck first, did you not?

lines.zh: 我看见你的武器了，我不退
lines.en: I saw your weapon; I do not retreat.

lines.zh: 我要证明我不是最小的
lines.en: I will prove I am not the smallest.

lines.zh: 你身上有味道，血的味道
lines.en: You have a smell: blood.
Do not run; I cannot catch you then.
The whole brood is fixed on you.
I charge first; follow me.

lines.zh: 主人说可以，那就是可以
lines.en: My master said yes, so it is yes.
Your ankle is bare; I claim it.
I have circled to your feet.
I keep low so you cannot see me.
My siblings take both sides.
Once I bite your trouser leg, I hold.

lines.zh: 你一转身，我就换个方向
lines.en: Turn, and I change direction.

lines.zh: 你左脚落地时总会慢半拍
lines.en: Your left foot always lands half a beat late.
We take turns; you get no rest.

lines.zh: 一步，两步，我记到第七步
lines.en: One step, two; I have counted seven.
Cut one down and ten remain.
Mother says holding you is enough.
I lick my teeth to get ready.

lines.zh: 墙在你背后，我们不用绕了
lines.en: The wall is at your back; no more circling.
I smell the sweat in your palms.
Small I may be, but my bite lands.

lines.zh: 我先咬你的脚踝，再退开
lines.en: I bite your ankle first, then back off
My teeth sank in and will not come out.
This bite is my very first.

lines.zh: 踢吧，我咬着你的裤脚不放
lines.en: Kick away; my teeth stay in your trouser leg.
My teeth are small, but numerous.
A small tear is enough.
You bleed; I did it.
Do not shake; you cannot throw us off.
I take the ankle; he takes the hand.
This one is for mother.
I back off for a breath, then return.
I came out of my mother's belly.

lines.zh: 落地第一件事是找主人
lines.en: My first act on landing was finding my master.
The whole brood opened its eyes together.
I ran before the slime dried.

lines.zh: 母亲叫我第十二只，没有别的
lines.en: Mother calls me the twelfth; nothing more.
Mother says being alive is being useful.

lines.zh: 我比兄弟姐妹矮半个头
lines.en: I am half a head shorter than my siblings.
The bell rang once when I was born.

lines.zh: 我尝到的第一口是空气
lines.en: My first taste was air.

lines.zh: 主人看了我一眼就够了
lines.en: One glance from my master is enough.
I know I may not live long.
I could bite the moment I was born.
Twelve in this brood; I counted.

lines.zh: 我被生下来是为了打仗
lines.en: I was born for fighting.

lines.zh: 烧起来的时候我闻到自己
lines.en: While burning, I smelled myself.

lines.zh: 从桌子上摔下来，很丢脸
lines.en: Falling off the table is embarrassing.
The water holds me down; I am too short.
Blown in two, and still moving.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的背，钉进木板
lines.en: The arrow went through my back into the planks.

lines.zh: 魔法让我看见自己的骨头
lines.en: Your magic let me see my own bones.
I am hungry, but it is not my turn.
The thunder frightened me before it struck.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，母亲看不见了
lines.en: I fell, and mother can no longer see me.
